hero.headline: Delivering sustainable pharmaceutical Bottles and Closures for global healthcare, engineered with advanced innovation and protecting integrity of drug inside.

about.title: Where Formulation meets perfect packaging
about.description: At Product Armor we deliver pharmaceutical packaging products manufactured in controlled cleanroom facility and trusted by customers worldwide. Operating within an ISO Class 8 cleanroom environment, we specialize in high-quality containers / bottles and caps / closures that meet the rigorous demands of the pharmaceutical industry. With a vision focused on the future of healthcare, we are continuously advancing our capabilities to support next-generation packaging technologies and drug delivery devices for global markets.

products.name: Bottles & Containers
products.description: High quality pharmaceutical Bottles & Containers manufactured under ISO Class 8 certified cleanroom facility ensuring product protection, consistency and compliant with the stringent requirements of regulated pharmaceutical standards.
features: Automated manufacturing enabling precision, consistency and minimal human intervention throughout the production process.
Low-carbon manufacturing driven by innovative manufacturing technologies that significantly reduce carbon footprint
Advanced process controls with continuous monitoring of critical manufacturing parameters to ensure consistent product quality.
Precision-engineered performance designed for reliable filling, sealing, handling and storage across pharmaceutical applications.
Consistent product specifications delivering dimensional accuracy, dependable sealing performance and protection for product stability throughout its lifecycle.
Trusted by global pharmaceutical companies for reliability, consistency and supply assurance

products.name: Child-Resistant Closures (CRC)
products.description: Our patented technology delivers one of the lowest carbon footprints in Child-Resistant Closure (CRC) manufacturing.
features: Highly automated production ensuring precision, consistency and minimal human intervention.
Our CR closures are compliance with U.S. PPPA requirements under 16 CFR Part 1700.20.
Trusted by leading global pharmaceutical brands across a wide range of healthcare applications with an annual manufacturing capacity over 600 million CR closures.
Patented technology featuring a unique CRC manufacturing process, engineered for operational excellence, precision and consistent quality.
products.sizes: 28 mm, 33 mm, 38 mm, 45 mm & 53 mm with different colors

products.name: Continuous Thread Closures (CT)
products.description: Our Continuous Thread (CT) closures deliver secure sealing, product integrity and reliable supply with patented technology enabling one of the lowest carbon footprints in CT closure manufacturing.
features: Trusted by leading global pharmaceutical brands across a wide range of healthcare applications with an annual manufacturing capacity over 1 Billion CT closures.
Highly automated production ensuring precision, consistency and minimal human intervention.
Comprehensive testing & validation to meet stringent pharmaceutical industry requirements.
products.sizes: 28 mm, 33 mm, 38 mm & 53 mm with different colors

products.name: Advancing Beyond Packaging
products.description: Expanding into next-generation drug delivery solutions, including ophthalmic and other specialized delivery systems designed to support patient safety, dosing accuracy, and improved therapeutic outcomes.

openings.title: Production Engineer

requirements: Working knowledge of SPC and preventive maintenance

openings.title: QA Executive
openings.summary: Execute in-line and incoming quality checks, maintain batch records and CoAs, support ISO 9001:2015 audits, and drive corrective/preventive actions.
requirements: 1–4 yrs QA/QC in pharma or packaging
Familiarity with AQL sampling, GDP and documentation

openings.title: Sales Manager
openings.summary: Grow B2B relationships with pharmaceutical, nutraceutical and healthcare manufacturers — manage the enquiry-to-order cycle, coordinate samples and support export accounts.
requirements: Strong client relationship and negotiation skills
